# How we work here

**Candidates** answers *who is in the pipeline*. One row per candidate, the board shows the stage.

## No skipping stages

An interview happens only after a screening, an offer only after an interview. The board refuses jumps — move the card through each stage.

## Moving assigns

Taking a candidate to Interview assigns whoever moved the card. Hired stamps the date by itself.
